vb_textbox.text: In the first round, I tried to remember the colours that were awarding, what seemed like the highest points. In the second round I was noticing that I was getting a bigger score by looking at the last digit of my total, selecting the left gnome if the digit was odd and selecting the right gnome if it was even (treating 0 as even). After a good run it seemed that the direction changed (left for even and right for odd), but after a while it returned as before. Another hunch I had was to pick the left gnome when the multiplier was 'x1' and right gnome when it was 'x5', but I didn't get a chance at testing this theory as my odd/even tactic was doing well
